dashboards.name: Editube — Acquisition & Content
dashboards.definition: Consented visitor discovery through successful account creation.
dashboards.freshness: Browser events near-real-time; authoritative API events within the 5-minute outbox SLO.
dashboards.limitations: Consent suppresses some anonymous traffic; CTA behavior is intent, while account_created is authoritative.

insights.name: Visitor to account funnel
insights.denominator: Consented distinct people with a marketing page_viewed event
insights.definition: Ordered marketing visit, CTA intent, signup view/submission, and authoritative account creation.
insights.limitations: Cross-device journeys and visitors who reject analytics cannot be joined; pricing_plan_selected is an alternate CTA branch.

insights.name: Landing route traffic
insights.definition: Page views by normalized route template.
insights.limitations: Not a census of all visitors because capture is consent-dependent.

insights.name: CTA interest by placement
insights.denominator: Consented sessions where the named CTA was available
insights.definition: Named marketing CTA clicks, segmented by stable placement.
insights.limitations: This measures intent, not signup or paid conversion.

dashboards.name: Editube — Onboarding & Checkout
dashboards.definition: Account onboarding and the authoritative paid-conversion path.
dashboards.freshness: Client steps near-real-time; checkout/subscription truth within the 5-minute outbox SLO.
dashboards.limitations: checkout_completed is authoritative only when sourced by API/Stripe; open conversion windows must not be labeled abandoned.

insights.name: Account to onboarding completion
insights.denominator: New accounts old enough to complete the 7-day window
insights.definition: Ordered account creation, onboarding entry, authoritative profile/workflow completion, plan intent, and completion.
insights.limitations: The plan selection step is client intent; onboarding_completed is authoritative.

insights.name: Authoritative paid conversion
insights.denominator: Distinct people who intentionally started checkout and whose 48-hour window matured
insights.definition: Client checkout intent through Stripe-backed entitlement.
insights.limitations: Do not use the browser return page as proof of payment or entitlement.

insights.name: Checkout losses and failures
insights.definition: Matured abandonment, observed checkout errors, and explicit cancellation outcomes.
insights.limitations: checkout_abandoned is emitted only after the first-party 24-hour maturity window; client cancellation is an observed intent, not proof of non-conversion.

dashboards.name: Editube — Activation & Time to Value
dashboards.definition: New workspaces reaching their first durable value outcome.
dashboards.freshness: Authoritative server/worker events within the 5-minute outbox SLO.
dashboards.limitations: Targets require 2–4 complete baseline weeks; first value is once per workspace.

insights.name: Account to first value
insights.denominator: New eligible workspaces with a fully matured 7-day window
insights.definition: Ordered setup path to the first authoritative durable result.
insights.limitations: Account and workspace creation are not identical for invited members.

insights.name: First value by workflow feature
insights.definition: Distribution of the feature that produced first durable value.
insights.limitations: Only the first qualifying outcome per workspace is counted.

insights.name: Project setup outcomes
insights.definition: Successful and failed setup outcomes.
insights.limitations: Durations require event-level duration_ms coverage.

dashboards.name: Editube — Feature Adoption
dashboards.definition: Comparable feature exposure, start, completion, and result-use lifecycles.
dashboards.freshness: Client exposure near-real-time; authoritative outcomes within 5 minutes.
dashboards.limitations: Exposure requires a visible annotated control; autocapture clicks are not treated as adoption.

insights.name: Feature lifecycle conversion
insights.denominator: Eligible users who actually saw an annotated feature control
insights.definition: Ordered feature exposure, open, meaningful start, successful completion, and result use.
insights.limitations: Compare one feature_key at a time; eligibility is defined in the checked-in feature registry.

insights.name: Feature outcomes by feature
insights.definition: Completion, failure, cancellation, and value-use volume by feature.
insights.limitations: Raw volume is not an adoption rate until divided by an eligibility/exposure denominator.

insights.name: Activated workspace value retention
insights.definition: Weekly return to a durable feature result after activation.
insights.limitations: Recent cohorts are incomplete; workspace grouping must be enabled in PostHog.

insights.name: Editor session summaries
insights.denominator: Consented editor sessions that reached an editing workspace
insights.definition: One bounded summary per editor session with active/play time, edit/undo counts, tools used, export intent, and autosave-failure count.
insights.limitations: The event contains aggregates only; background time is excluded and abrupt browser termination can lose a page-leave summary.

dashboards.name: Editube — Retention & Cohorts
dashboards.definition: Value retention after activation, not login retention.
dashboards.freshness: 5 minutes with incomplete recent periods excluded during review.
dashboards.limitations: W4/W8 decisions need mature cohorts and stable instrumentation.

insights.name: W1/W4/W8 value retention
insights.denominator: Activated workspaces whose relevant week has matured
insights.definition: Workspace return to a durable result-use event after activation.
insights.limitations: Do not compare incomplete weeks with mature cohorts.

insights.name: Paid value-active workspaces
insights.definition: Weekly durable value activity segmented by plan.
insights.limitations: Requires complete plan and workspace grouping context on events.

insights.name: Activation volume by plan
insights.definition: First-value outcomes by plan cohort.
insights.limitations: Counts are not rates without the eligible new-workspace denominator.

dashboards.name: Editube — Revenue & Subscriptions
dashboards.definition: Stripe-backed subscription, invoice, cancellation, and churn lifecycle.
dashboards.freshness: Webhook processing plus the 5-minute analytics outbox SLO.
dashboards.limitations: PostHog is a behavioral view; PostgreSQL/Stripe remain financial truth for booked revenue.

insights.name: Subscription lifecycle
insights.definition: Paid subscription state transitions by plan.
insights.limitations: Scheduled cancellation is not effective churn.

insights.name: Matured trial conversion
insights.denominator: Trials whose full conversion opportunity has matured
insights.definition: Trial start through first paid invoice.
insights.limitations: Exclude still-open trials from the denominator.

insights.name: Payment and churn risk
insights.denominator: Paid subscriptions at risk or churned
insights.definition: Payment failures, past-due transitions, and effective churn.
insights.limitations: Use amount_minor from the lifecycle table for audited revenue calculations.

dashboards.name: Editube — Reliability & User Impact
dashboards.definition: Normalized user-impact events paired with Sentry exception and trace detail.
dashboards.freshness: Sentry near-real-time; outbox events within 5 minutes.
dashboards.limitations: PostHog error events intentionally omit stacks and raw messages; investigate detail in Sentry.

insights.name: Background job outcomes
insights.definition: Completion, retry, and failure outcomes by stable job type.
insights.limitations: Maintenance jobs are intentionally excluded from product job analytics.

insights.name: User-facing runtime failures
insights.denominator: Affected requests, media sessions, sockets, or rendered routes
insights.definition: Privacy-safe failure facts that can be segmented by funnel context.
insights.limitations: Counts are impact signals; Sentry owns issue fingerprints and stack traces.

insights.name: Feature failures
insights.definition: Failed feature operations by feature key.
insights.limitations: A rate requires the matching start denominator and consistent job mappings.

dashboards.name: Editube — Review & Delivery
dashboards.definition: Workspace-level review engagement and conversion to approval/delivery.
dashboards.freshness: Review/API facts within the 5-minute outbox SLO; granular heatmaps remain first-party.
dashboards.limitations: PostHog receives milestones and summaries only, never granular progress or guest content.

insights.name: Review cycle funnel
insights.definition: Review link creation through engagement, decision, and delivery.
insights.limitations: Comment and approval are alternative valid outcomes, so inspect branching paths as well as this ordered view.

insights.name: Review playback milestones
insights.denominator: Unique review sessions with playback progress
insights.definition: Deduplicated 25/50/75/100 playback milestones.
insights.limitations: Per-second unique viewers and rewatch hotspots remain in PostgreSQL review analytics.

insights.name: Review and delivery outcomes
insights.definition: Authoritative feedback, decision, signoff, and download outcomes.
insights.limitations: Raw guest identity and comment content are intentionally excluded.
